profiles.title: PWR-VCC
profiles.source: Rail flag glyph, measured on 534 r1 from the landed page's own render: `.tmp_534/final-postcheck-r1/actual.svg`, sha256 743de22379a24dde247a0673eca143f3d3b43cbbd33f92d48c2ea93b5458adfb. 14 flags on that page (3 VCC / 7 +5V / 4 GND); each rail flag's glyph is a 5-unit lead then a 10-wide pennant hanging away from the connection — `(-5, 0, 5, 10) + family rotation 0` puts the predicted box exactly on the drawn one for 3/3 VCC and 7/7 +5V (delta [0,0,0,0]; no other body did). Numbers and per-flag table: `.tmp_534/text-profile-measurement-r1/findings.md` sec.1.2 / measurements.json. Supersedes the carry-over `(-6, 0, 6, 18)` from blocklib/specs/ch340_serial.library.json, whose source records the 2026-10-03 family probe (pit 43: connection point at the origin, PinLength 5); the flag *family* reading is unchanged, only its extent is now the measured one.

profiles.title: PWR-GND
profiles.source: Ground flag glyph, measured on 534 r1 off the landed render (`actual.svg`, sha256 743de22379a24dde247a0673eca143f3d3b43cbbd33f92d48c2ea93b5458adfb): a 10-unit lead then 20-wide bars, i.e. `(-10, 0, 10, 19)` with the family's 180 rotation putting them below the connection point. 4/4 GND flags predicted exactly (delta [0,0,0,0]); the family still prints **no** name (4/4 have no text node — confirmed again on this page). Evidence: `.tmp_534/text-profile-measurement-r1/findings.md` sec.1.2/1.3. Supersedes the carry-over `(-6, 0, 6, 18)`; the 2026-10-03 probe's reading (connection point at the origin, PinLength 10, bars 9.5..19.5 below) is unchanged, only the extent is now measured.
